name: Alila Villas Uluwatu
insider_take: Perched dramatically on limestone cliffs 100 meters above the Indian Ocean, this architectural masterpiece redefines clifftop luxury with its award-winning sustainable design and breathtaking panoramic views.
whats_special: Each villa features a private infinity pool that appears to cascade into the ocean below, while the resort's bamboo and sustainable architecture earned it the prestigious Green Building Council of Indonesia award. The property sits just minutes from the iconic Uluwatu Temple, one of Bali's most sacred sea temples built in the 11th century.
pro_tip: Book a villa on the resort's western edge for unobstructed sunset views, and time your stay during the dry season (April-October) when the famous Kecak fire dance performances at nearby Uluwatu Temple aren't affected by rain.
dont_miss: The resort's clifftop cabana dining experience at sunset, and the world-class spa treatments in pavilions suspended over the cliff edge. Explore the hidden Suluban Beach below via a scenic trek through limestone caves, or catch some of the world's best surfing at the legendary Uluwatu break just steps away.
pros: Spectacular clifftop location with panoramic Indian Ocean views
Award-winning sustainable architecture and eco-friendly design
Private pool villas with exceptional privacy and luxury
World-class spa treatments with traditional Balinese wellness practices
cons: Remote clifftop location requires transportation to reach beaches and attractions
